theme: A wide-open family day — no meetings, and Disney two days out.
greeting: The calendar's clear, Dan — the day belongs to you and the four girls at the villa, with the Disney weekend on the horizon.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV before it sells out
needsAttention.detail: In Todoist, flagged p1 and overdue since Sept 14. The Pathfinder heads south in October, so Christmas week needs a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland — the thinnest rental in that market over the holidays, and waiting genuinely costs money.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open piece for Saturday
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando villa and lodging are set for the Sept 26–27 Disney weekend with all four girls; tickets for six are the one item still marked open. Worth confirming whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the St Pete stay after the villa
needsAttention.detail: The St Pete rental for Sept 27–Oct 5, your next stop when the Orlando villa checks out, was left pending host confirmation after the Sept 18 charge. Worth a glance that it converted to a firm booking.

schedule.title: Open — no meetings
schedule.detail: The widest clear stretch of your week, with the girls at the villa.

schedule.title: Julia's birthday
schedule.detail: A recurring reminder on your calendar.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley flags a CashPlus fee
flagged.detail: The CashPlus account ending 1305 isn't currently meeting fee-avoidance and may be charged; a transfer this week may head it off.

flagged.title: Public-policy role in your job alerts
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced an 'SVP, Global Public Policy' posting and similar roles, in the governance and public-affairs lane you're searching.

inbox.noise: Newsletters and receipts — WSJ, Responsible Investor, the St Pete and Maine locals, a shipped book order, a couple of survey nudges.
inbox.clear: Nothing else awaiting your reply, and no security mail.

recipe.why: An autumn soup that leans on the season's just-dug sweet potatoes and a bright pickled finish.

acts.line: The calendar is empty until evening, so the whole morning is yours to spend as you like.
A villa day in Orlando with the four girls, Disney now two days out on Saturday.
Julia's birthday sits at five — a quiet reminder on the calendar, nothing that needs planning.
